The more you stake into the raid, the bigger your cut when the nociceptor flatlines. Your share is your contribution divided by the total pool, paid the moment it fires.

How the raid works

01
The whole community raids one boss. Every stake overloads the nociceptor. The bounty pool grows with every contribution across pain.bet.
02
Contribute to climb. The more you stake, the higher your share of the bounty and the higher you sit on the raiders board. Your projected payout updates live.
03
Pressure hits critical. At 85 percent overload the core runs hot. The next stakes can push it past the firing threshold.
04
It flatlines and pays. Cross 50,000 USDT and the boss discharges. The bounty is split by contribution, everyone holding is paid, then a fresh nociceptor spawns.

    Terms

    1 · The service
    Pain.bet is a crypto-only casino operated under an Anjouan gaming licence. By opening an account you confirm you are 18 or older and that online gambling is legal in your jurisdiction.
    2 · Accounts and wallets
    One account per person. Your connected wallet is your identity; keys are never held by the house. Balances are denominated in USDT with multi-chain deposit rails.
    3 · Bets and settlement
    All Originals settle against published, provably fair math at a fixed 1% house edge. Provider games settle per provider rules. Settled bets are final.
    4 · Bonuses
    Bonus terms, wagering weights and caps are stated on each promotion. Anesthesia and PK Relief carry no wagering. Abuse voids rewards.
    Data we hold
    Wallet addresses, bet history, and the minimum required for compliance. No selling of data, ever.
    Cookies
    Strictly functional: session, preferences, fraud prevention. No third party ad trackers.
    Retention
    Compliance data is kept only as long as the licence requires, then purged.
    Policy
    Deposits and withdrawals are monitored on-chain. Structuring, mixing-service proximity, and sanctioned-address exposure trigger review.
    Verification threshold
    Play below the threshold requires no KYC. Cumulative withdrawals above it trigger a one-time verification.
    Reporting
    Suspicious activity is reported to the licensing authority as required by law.
    How it works
    Every Originals round derives its outcome from server seed + client seed + nonce. The server seed hash is shown before you bet; the seed is revealed after rotation so you can verify every round yourself.
    Verify
    Open any settled round, copy the seeds into the verifier, and recompute the result. Same seeds, same outcome, every time.
    The edge
    All nine Originals run a fixed 1% house edge. Published, certified, identical in the PK arcade.
    18+ only
    Gambling involves risk. Only play with what you can afford to lose.
    Your tools
    Deposit limits, loss limits, session reminders, cool-off, and permanent self-exclusion are available in your account, effective immediately.
    Help
    If gambling stops being fun, reach out: BeGambleAware.org, Gamblers Anonymous, or your local support line. Support can enable self-exclusion for you at any time.
